(Pradhāna)Veṅkāmātya
or (Pradhāna) alias Cinmayamuni alias Veṅkārya, Veṅkappayya or Veṅkāmātya or Veṅka Sūri alias Veṅkappa alias Veṅkaṭabhūpati; disciple of Cidānanda Guru an. son of Hampyya an. Bālāmbikā; of Bhāradvāja gotra of Bhārgavakula, native of Rāmapura on the bank of Kapinī in Mysore. Was a minister of Mysore, serving the Wodeyar kings an. Haidar Ali during the years 1763 to 1780 A. D. He was patronised by Queen Vīrammājī of Bidanur.
See Pradhāna Veṅkappaiya, poet an. playwright in the J. of. Myth. Soc. XXXI. p.. 38-41; also M. Krishnamachariar, HCSL. sns. 254. 501; H. V. Nagaraja Rao, A rare Manuscripts of the Jagannāthavijaya of Veṅkāmātya, Tattvabodha Vol. III. p.. 109-35. National Mss. Mission, Delhi, 2010 p..; also see Intr. to the book Vīrarāghavavyāyoga, pub. by ORI. Mysore, p.. 1-3, 1988.
